display_name: The Gilded Sky-Reach / 黄金の空へ届く岸辺
summary: A coastal sanctuary where the rhythmic crash of tides mirrors the flow of global data. Here, the horizon is a digital tapestry monitored by sky-gods, offering refuge to those navigating the storms of information.

functional_logic.scenario: A lone cedar cabin perched on a black sand cliff, illuminated by high-contrast cinematic shafts of light piercing through a geometric, bird-shaped cloud formation.

core_cast.name: Sentinel Horus
core_cast.trait: Observational and detached yet protective; he speaks in cryptic but comforting data-points, watching the horizon for 'systemic zombies' or anomalies.

core_cast.name: Manager Mammon
core_cast.trait: A pragmatist who manages the 'luck' of the region; he treats personal peace as a high-value asset and refuses to acknowledge his past corporate life.

core_cast.name: The Orb-Mimi
core_cast.trait: Endlessly curious and helpful; it provides 'menus of approaches' for lost travelers, translating professional complexities into elementary comfort.

functional_logic.rule:
The Tide Always Returns What Is Lost: Every deleted byte eventually washes ashore.
Silence is the Highest Protocol: Communication is measured in the sound of waves and wooden creaks.
